ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Arabic word means "thank you"? (1 mark)
   A. مَرْحَبًا
   B. اسْمِي
   C. مَسَاءُ الْخَيْرِ
   D. شُكْرًا

2. Which Kiswahili word comes from the Arabic word kitaab? (1 mark)
   A. kitabu
   B. maji
   C. nyumba
   D. mti

3. How is the Arabic word مَرْحَبًا read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. anaa bi-khayr
   B. marhaban
   C. sabaahu l-khayr
   D. maʿa s-salaama

4. What does the Arabic sentence عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a brother and a sister.
   B. This is my mother.
   C. This is my father.
   D. My father works.

5. Which Arabic sentence means "I have a brother and a sister." (1 mark)
   A. أَبِي يَعْمَلُ
   B. عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ
   C. هَذَا أَبِي
   D. هَذِهِ أُمِّي

6. Which Arabic word means "cat"? (1 mark)
   A. كِتَابٌ
   B. قِطَّةٌ
   C. طَاوِلَةٌ
   D. كُوبٌ

7. How is the Arabic word افْتَحِ الْبَابَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. iftahi l-baab
   B. ilmis anfaka
   C. ukhruj
   D. ismaʿ

8. What does the Arabic word اُكْتُبْ (uktub) mean? (1 mark)
   A. come in
   B. raise your hand
   C. close the door
   D. write

9. What does the Arabic word عِيدٌ (ʿiid) mean? (1 mark)
   A. friend
   B. song
   C. festival
   D. no

10. Which Arabic sentence means "Happy birthday." (1 mark)
   A. عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ
   B. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ
   C. كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ
   D. هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟

11. What does the Arabic word طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) mean? (1 mark)
   A. food
   B. friend
   C. please, go ahead
   D. birthday

12. How is the Arabic word زَهْرَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. sahaab
   B. zahra
   C. nadhiif
   D. haarr

13. How do you read the syllable دُ? (1 mark)
   A. ba
   B. si
   C. du
   D. li

14. How do you read the syllable قَا? (1 mark)
   A. da
   B. nu
   C. qaa
   D. ba

15. What is the name of the Arabic letter ا? (1 mark)
   A. nuun
   B. Saad
   C. alif
   D. daal

16. Which pair of syllables makes the word ukhtun (sister)? (1 mark)
   A. tun + a
   B. bin + tun
   C. khu + ta
   D. ukh + tun

17. Which strategy uses a picture or the sentence to guess a word? (1 mark)
   A. Clapping
   B. Cues
   C. Copying
   D. Decoding only

18. How do you read the syllable مُو? (1 mark)
   A. muu
   B. bu
   C. ta
   D. ja

19. What does the Arabic sentence الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The house is big.
   B. How are you? (to a girl)
   C. In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
   D. On the table there is a cup.

20. Which Arabic word means "plate"? (1 mark)
   A. مَطْبَخٌ
   B. غُرْفَةٌ
   C. سِكِّينٌ
   D. صَحْنٌ

21. What does the Arabic sentence أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I visit my grandmother on Friday.
   B. I read a book on Sunday.
   C. I help my mother on Saturday.
   D. I drink water.

22. Which Arabic word means "food"? (1 mark)
   A. شَمْعَةٌ
   B. تَفَضَّلْ
   C. بَالُونٌ
   D. طَعَامٌ

23. What does the Arabic sentence السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Water is useful (good for you).
   B. The fish is delicious.
   C. I like food.
   D. The juice is cold.

24. How is the Arabic word حَدِيقَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. saaʿa
   B. matbakh
   C. hadiiqa
   D. kuub

25. Which word fills the gap in: ashrabu ____ (I drink the juice)? (1 mark)
   A. al-hafla
   B. baaluun
   C. al-ʿasiira
   D. al-kaʿka

26. Which Arabic sentence means "I have a gift." (1 mark)
   A. أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ
   B. أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ
   C. عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ
   D. نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ

27. How wide should the space between two words be? (1 mark)
   A. No space at all
   B. As wide as a word
   C. As wide as a line
   D. About the width of one letter

28. Which Arabic sentence means "I clean my teeth." (1 mark)
   A. رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ
   B. يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ
   C. أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي
   D. أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي

29. Which word means 'sun'? (1 mark)
   A. sahaab
   B. riih
   C. matar
   D. shams

30. Which Arabic word means "at (near, by)"? (1 mark)
   A. عَلَى
   B. تَحْتَ
   C. عِنْدَ
   D. أَمَامَ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate: al-qittatu taHta s-sariir. al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila. (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Spell the word الخميس by naming its letters in order. (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Translate into English: ʿiid mubaarak (2 marks)

34. Describe how to copy a family word neatly. (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Translate into English: haadhihi shams (2 marks)

36. Translate into English: al-ʿasiiru baarid (2 marks)

37. Translate into English: marhaban yaa Ahmad (2 marks)

38. Write five things or rooms found in a home in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

39. Translate into English: aakulu l-khubza (2 marks)

40. Translate into English: lii ʿaynaani (2 marks)

41. Write four parts of the body in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

42. Describe two ways in which your class can look after the school environment. (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Explain why vocabulary building helps you to learn Arabic. (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa (2 marks)

45. Match these to their Arabic names: chair, bed, kitchen. Write the sounds. (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Write a short speech of at least four sentences about your house in Arabic sounds (English letters). Give the meaning. (5 marks) (5 marks)

47. Translate into English: al-mawzu ladhiidh (2 marks)

48. Read the sentence هَذِهِ أُمِّي and give its meaning. Say which family word it contains. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — شُكْرًا
   شُكْرًا (shukran) means thank you.

2. A — kitabu
   The Kiswahili word kitabu (book) came from Arabic kitaab. The other words are Bantu words.

3. B — marhaban
   مَرْحَبًا is read marhaban and means hello.

4. A — I have a brother and a sister.
   عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ (ʿindii akh wa ukht) means: I have a brother and a sister.

5. B — عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ
   عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ (ʿindii akh wa ukht) means: I have a brother and a sister.

6. B — قِطَّةٌ
   قِطَّةٌ (qitta) means cat.

7. A — iftahi l-baab
   افْتَحِ الْبَابَ is read iftahi l-baab and means open the door.

8. D — write
   اُكْتُبْ (uktub) means write.

9. C — festival
   عِيدٌ (ʿiid) means festival.

10. B — عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ
   عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ (ʿiid miilaad saʿiid) means: Happy birthday.

11. A — food
   طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) means food.

12. B — zahra
   زَهْرَةٌ is read zahra and means flower.

13. C — du
   دُ is read du.

14. C — qaa
   قَا is read qaa.

15. C — alif
   The letter ا is called alif.

16. D — ukh + tun
   ukh-tun is the word for sister.

17. B — Cues
   Cues are clues such as pictures and the words around the new word.

18. A — muu
   مُو is read muu.

19. A — The house is big.
   الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baytu kabiir) means: The house is big.

20. D — صَحْنٌ
   صَحْنٌ (sahn) means plate.

21. A — I visit my grandmother on Friday.
   أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ (azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa) means: I visit my grandmother on Friday.

22. D — طَعَامٌ
   طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) means food.

23. B — The fish is delicious.
   السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ (as-samaku ladhiidh) means: The fish is delicious.

24. C — hadiiqa
   حَدِيقَةٌ is read hadiiqa and means garden.

25. C — al-ʿasiira
   We drink juice, not cake, a party or a balloon.

26. C — عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ
   عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ (ʿindii hadiyya) means: I have a gift.

27. D — About the width of one letter
   A small even space keeps words apart without breaking the sentence.

28. D — أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي
   أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي (unadhdhifu asnaanii) means: I clean my teeth.

29. D — shams
   shams means sun.

30. C — عِنْدَ
   عِنْدَ (ʿinda) means at (near, by).

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cat is under the bed. The lamp is above the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: alif, laam, khaa, miim, yaa, siin.
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all six letters in order; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say the word aloud; look at each letter and mark; write it once and compare with the model; correct and write it again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: The juice is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Hello, Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: I eat bread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example raʾs (head), ʿayn (eye), fam (mouth), yad (hand).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Plant and water trees; put rubbish in bins; keep water clean; sweep the compound.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way and 1 mark for a reason.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: The more words you know, the more you can understand, say and write. Grouping words by theme helps you to remember them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for understanding, 1 mark for speaking or writing and 1 mark for remembering.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: I visit my grandmother on Friday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: chair is kursii, bed is sariir, kitchen is matbakh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. ismii Amina. haadhaa baytii. fii baytii matbakh. shukran li-istimaaʿikum. (Peace be upon you. My name is Amina. This is my house. In my house there is a kitchen. Thank you for listening.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a greeting, 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the topic sentence, 1 mark for a detail and 1 mark for the closing thanks.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: The banana is delicious.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: haadhihi ummii. This is my mother. It contains umm (mother).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reading, 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for the family word.
